facts.fact: The TCIB scheme operated by PayInc is live into Botswana through First Capital Bank Botswana, which can now receive money instantly from South Africa via SendHome and from Zimbabwe via ZB Bank, per TechAfrica News.
Botswana is now a live corridor of TCIB, the cross-border scheme PayInc operates as SADC Regional Settlement Operator for the SADC region, per TechAfrica News.
